messages.subject: fit measures not shown
parts:
Hi lavaan community,

Thank you for making this package and letting us use it for free. It is incredible.

I used time lag models and did multiple group analysis - if the two models are the same or not: the model constraining all parameters to be the same and the model to let them freely estimated. But I do not see any fit measures (RMSEA, TLI), and reviewers are asking those. How can I get the fit measures? 

I pasted my code and results below. Is there anything wrong in the way I used lavaan or sem function?

I would really appreciate your reply.

> mn<-
+ '
+ MPC16~MPC13+NBA13
+ NBA16~MPC13+NBA13
+ '
